name: @kitora/tour
description: Kitora's onboarding kit: a framework-free tour machine (steps, progress, resume, route-aware), spotlight maths, checklist and announcement models, with headless React hooks and styled presets (tour popover on the overlay kit, beacons, coach marks, onboarding checklist, what's new); the stepper is re-exported from the feedback kit.

exports.name: sortAnnouncements
exports.description: Newest first; ties keep their input order.

exports.name: visibleAnnouncements
exports.description: The announcements dated on or after `since` (all when null), newest first.
exports.signature: (items: readonly Announcement[], since?: string | null) => readonly Announcement[]

exports.name: unseenAnnouncements
exports.description: The visible announcements this user has not seen.
exports.signature: (items: readonly Announcement[], seen: readonly string[], since?: string | null) => readonly Announcement[]

exports.name: Announcement
exports.description: One dated entry in the "What's new" feed.

exports.name: checklistProgress
exports.description: Counts the required tasks done and finds the next open task.

exports.description: The saved state, or null when nothing valid is saved.

exports.name: ChecklistItem
exports.description: One task in the onboarding checklist.

props.description: Ids of the tasks that are done, in the order they were ticked.

props.name: collapsed
props.description: Whether the checklist widget is collapsed to its header.

props.name: dismissed
props.description: Whether the user has dismissed the checklist.

exports.name: INITIAL_CHECKLIST_STATE
exports.description: The empty checklist state: nothing done, expanded, not dismissed.

exports.name: ChecklistAction
exports.description: An action for `checklistReducer`: tick, untick or toggle a task, collapse, dismiss, restore or reset the checklist.

exports.name: ChecklistProgress
exports.description: How far the user is through the required tasks, from `checklistProgress`.

exports.name: CHECKLIST_SNAPSHOT_VERSION

exports.name: inflateRect
exports.description: `rect` grown by `padding` on every side.

exports.name: clipRect
exports.description: `rect` clipped to the viewport; null when nothing of it is visible.

exports.name: isRectInView
exports.description: True when the whole rect (plus `margin`) is inside the viewport, i.e. no scroll is needed to show it.
exports.signature: (rect: Rect, viewport: Size, margin?: number) => boolean

exports.name: sameRect
exports.description: Two rects equal to the pixel; the renderer skips a state update when the target has not moved.
exports.signature: (a: Rect | null, b: Rect | null) => boolean

exports.name: spotlightPath
exports.description:
An SVG path for the backdrop: the full viewport, then the hole as a rounded
rect, filled with `fill-rule="evenodd"` so the hole is transparent. `hole`
null = a full backdrop (a centred step). The radius is clamped to half the
hole's shorter side so a thin target still gets a valid path.
exports.signature: (viewport: Size, hole: Rect | null, radius?: number) => string

exports.name: centeredAnchor
exports.description: The anchor rect for a step with no target: a point a third of the way down the viewport's centre line.

exports.name: Rect
exports.description: A rectangle in viewport coordinates, px.

exports.name: Size
exports.description: A width and height in px.

exports.name: DEFAULT_SPOTLIGHT_PADDING
exports.description: Default gap between the target's edge and the hole's edge, px.

exports.name: DEFAULT_SPOTLIGHT_RADIUS
exports.description: Default corner radius of the hole, px.

exports.name: STEP_STATES
exports.description: Every visual state a step can be in, as {@link stepStates} resolves it.

exports.name: STEPPER_ORIENTATIONS
exports.description: The directions a stepper lays its steps out in.

exports.name: STEPPER_NAVIGATION
exports.description:
`linear`: a step can be opened once every step before it is complete (and you
can always go back); `free`: any step that is not disabled.

exports.description: The state of each of `count` steps. Precedence: error, finished, then current, disabled, complete, upcoming.
exports.signature: (count: number, active: number, flags?: StepFlags) => readonly StepState[]

exports.name: canSelectStep
exports.description: Whether step `index` may be opened from `active` under `navigation`.
exports.signature: (index: number, active: number, states: readonly StepState[], navigation: StepperNavigation) => boolean

exports.name: StepState
exports.description: One of {@link STEP_STATES}.

exports.name: StepperOrientation
exports.description: One of {@link STEPPER_ORIENTATIONS}.

exports.name: StepperNavigation
exports.description: One of {@link STEPPER_NAVIGATION}.

exports.name: StepFlags
exports.description: What the host knows about the steps beyond the active index: which are complete, errored or disabled, and whether the flow is done.

exports.name: memoryStorage
exports.description: An in-memory store: the SSR and test default, and what a host passes to opt out of persistence.

exports.name: safeJson

exports.name: isRecord

exports.description: A stored list of ids (seen announcements, dismissed beacons); anything else reads as empty.

exports.description: The list with `id` added once (order kept, so the oldest stays first).

exports.name: KeyValueStorage
exports.description: A key-value store of strings. Synchronous on purpose: a remote store caches and writes behind.

exports.name: stepApplies
exports.description: True when the step applies to this context (no `when` = always).
exports.signature: <B, C>(step: TourStep<B, C>, context: C) => boolean

exports.description: First index at or after `from` (moving by `dir`) whose step applies; -1 when none.

exports.name: tourReducer
exports.description:
The tour reducer. Pure: the same state, action, steps and context always give
the same next state. Actions that make no sense in the current status return
the state unchanged (Next on an idle tour), so a double click never corrupts it.
exports.signature: <B, C>(state: TourState, action: TourAction, steps: readonly TourStep<B, C>[], context: C) => TourState

exports.name: tourProgress
exports.description: Progress among the steps that apply to this context.
exports.signature: <B, C>(state: TourState, steps: readonly TourStep<B, C>[], context: C) => TourProgress

exports.name: canResume
exports.description: True when a saved state can be resumed: it was left mid-way, on a step that still exists and applies.
exports.signature: <B, C>(state: TourState, steps: readonly TourStep<B, C>[], context: C) => boolean

exports.name: serializeTour
exports.description: The saved form of a tour's state. The step id is kept so a reordered tour resumes on the same step.
exports.signature: <B, C>(state: TourState, steps: readonly TourStep<B, C>[]) => string

exports.name: parseTour
exports.description: The state saved by `serializeTour`, or null when nothing (valid) is saved or its step no longer exists.
exports.signature: <B, C>(text: string | null, steps: readonly TourStep<B, C>[]) => TourState | null

exports.name: TOUR_STATUSES
exports.description: Where a tour is in its life. `completed` = reached the end; `skipped` = closed early (Skip, Escape, ×).

exports.name: TourStatus
exports.description: Where a tour is in its life: one of `TOUR_STATUSES`.

exports.name: TOUR_SIDES

exports.name: TOUR_ALIGNS

exports.name: TourAlign
exports.description: How a step's popover lines up along its side: one of `TOUR_ALIGNS`.

exports.name: MISSING_TARGET_POLICIES
exports.description:

exports.name: MissingTargetPolicy
exports.description: What a step does when its target is missing: one of `MISSING_TARGET_POLICIES`.

exports.name: ADVANCE_TRIGGERS
exports.description: What makes a step advance by itself: nothing (the Next button) or a click on its target.

exports.name: AdvanceTrigger
exports.description: What makes a step advance by itself: one of `ADVANCE_TRIGGERS`.

exports.name: TourStep
exports.description: One step. `Body` is the content type: a string in plain data, a ReactNode in the React layer.

exports.name: TourState

props.description: Where the tour is in its life.

props.name: index

exports.name: INITIAL_TOUR_STATE
exports.description: The state of a tour that has not started: idle at the first step.

exports.name: TourAction
exports.description: An action for `tourReducer`: start, move, skip, complete, reset or restore a saved state.

exports.name: TourProgress
exports.description: Where the user is in the tour, from `tourProgress`.

exports.name: TOUR_SNAPSHOT_VERSION
exports.description: Version of the saved shape; bump on an incompatible change and old values read as nothing saved.

exports.name: localStorageAdapter
exports.description: `localStorage` under `prefix`; falls back to memory when storage is unavailable (SSR, blocked).

exports.name: tourTarget
exports.description: `{ "data-tour": key }`, to spread on a target element.

exports.name: isVisibleTarget
exports.description: A rendered, visible element (not `display: none`, not zero-size).

exports.name: waitForTarget
exports.description:
Resolves `key`, waiting up to `timeoutMs` for it to appear (a route that is
still loading, a panel that animates in). Resolves to null on timeout or abort.
exports.signature: (key: string, resolve: TargetResolver, timeoutMs: number, signal?: AbortSignal) => Promise<Element | null>

exports.name: viewportSize
exports.description: The window's inner size in px; zero on the server.

exports.name: toRect
exports.description: Copies a `DOMRect` into a plain `Rect`.

exports.name: observeRect
exports.description:
Calls `onChange` with the element's viewport rect whenever it moves or
resizes (scrolling, layout shifts, animations). One rAF loop that reads one
rect per frame and reports only real changes; returns the cleanup.

exports.name: prefersReducedMotion
exports.description: True when the user asked the system for less motion.

exports.name: revealTarget
exports.description:
Scrolls `el` to the middle of its scroll container when it is not fully in
view (margin `margin`). Smooth unless reduced motion is on. Returns whether it scrolled.

exports.name: TargetResolver
exports.description: Finds the element for a step's target key; returns null when it is not on the page.

exports.name: TOUR_TARGET_ATTRIBUTE
exports.description: The attribute the default resolver looks for: `<button data-tour="new-project">`.

exports.name: defaultTargetResolver
exports.description: The default resolver: `[data-tour="<key>"]` first, then the key as a CSS selector; null on the server or for an invalid selector.

exports.name: useAnnouncements
exports.description: The "What's new" feed with a persisted seen list, newest first; unseen counts stay 0 until storage has been read.
exports.signature: ({ items, id, since, storage, seen: seenIds, onSeenChange }: UseAnnouncementsOptions) => AnnouncementsController

exports.name: UseAnnouncementsOptions
exports.description: Options for `useAnnouncements`: the feed, its storage key, a `since` cut-off and an optional host-owned seen list.

exports.name: AnnouncementsController
exports.description: What `useAnnouncements` returns: the visible and unseen announcements and ways to mark them seen.

exports.name: useChecklist
exports.description: The onboarding checklist with persisted, controlled-or-uncontrolled state; calls `onComplete` once when the last required task is ticked.
exports.signature: ({ id, items, state: controlled, defaultState, onStateChange, onComplete, storage: storageOption }: UseChecklistOptions) => ChecklistController

exports.name: UseChecklistOptions
exports.description: Options for `useChecklist`: the tasks, a storage key and controlled or uncontrolled state.

exports.name: ChecklistController
exports.description: What `useChecklist` returns: the tasks, state and progress, and the actions that change them.

exports.name: useControllable
exports.description: Controlled-or-uncontrolled state: uses `value` when defined, else its own state seeded by `defaultValue`; the setter calls `onChange` in both modes.
exports.signature: <T>(value: T | undefined, defaultValue: T, onChange?: (next: T) => void) => readonly [T, (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void]

exports.name: useTargetRect
exports.description: The element's live viewport rect, following scroll, resize and layout shifts; null when there is no element.

exports.name: useViewportSize
exports.description: The window's inner size, updated on resize; zero until mounted.

exports.name: useSeenSet
exports.description: A persisted set of seen ids under `key`, read after mount and kept in step across hooks on the same key; host-owned when `control.seen` is set.
exports.signature: (key: string, storageOption?: StorageOption, control?: SeenSetControl) => SeenSet

exports.name: SEEN_CHANGE_EVENT
exports.description: The window event a write fires; `detail` is the key.

exports.name: SeenSet
exports.description: A persisted set of seen ids and the ways to change it, from `useSeenSet`.

exports.name: SeenSetControl
exports.description: The controlled half of a seen set: a host-owned list and its change callback.

exports.name: useStepper
exports.description: The stepper model for a wizard: the active step (controlled or not), each step's state and which steps can be selected.
exports.signature: ({ count, active: controlled, defaultActive, onActiveChange, navigation, completed, errors, disabled, finished }: UseStepperOptions) => StepperController

exports.name: UseStepperOptions
exports.description: What {@link useStepper} tracks: the step count, the active index (controlled or not), the navigation policy and the {@link StepFlags}.

exports.name: StepperController
exports.description: What {@link useStepper} returns: the active index, each step's state, and the calls that move between steps under the navigation policy.

exports.name: useStorage
exports.description: Resolves a `StorageOption` to a store, once per adapter identity.

exports.name: StorageOption
exports.description: Where a hook persists: left out for localStorage, `null` for memory only, or a host `KeyValueStorage` adapter.

exports.name: useTour
exports.description: The product tour hook: runs the steps through `tourReducer`, persists progress for Resume, finds and reveals each step's target, follows routes and binds ←, → (swapped in right-to-left text) and Escape.

exports.name: ReactTourStep
exports.description: A tour step whose title and body are React nodes.

exports.name: TourRouter
exports.description:
The router seam: how a tour that spans pages moves between them. The host
wraps its own router (TanStack, React Router, Next, a tab state) in these
two functions; the tour never imports a router.

exports.name: TARGET_STATUSES
exports.description: Where the current step's target is: still being looked for, on the page, or not found after the wait.

exports.name: TOUR_CARD_ATTRIBUTE
exports.description: The attribute a tour card carries; keys pressed inside it always belong to the tour.

exports.description: How long a step waits for its target to appear before its `whenMissing` policy applies.
